measurement.environment: local Node node:sqlite in-memory database with deployed SQL migrations; not hosted network latency

operational_bounds.over_budget: HTTP 413 with retryable=true and suggested_limit; 1000-entity large-alias fixture rejected, 500-entity retry passed

invariants_checked: one exact shared-priority winner per location/attribute
explicit unknown and disputed evidence never replaced by weaker values
preferred names at all six tiers and settlements
UTF-16 claim ID tie-breaking matches shared resolver
all scoped withdrawals prevent prepared fallback resurrection
mid-page changes reject atomically with retryable revision conflict
metadata summaries retain habitation and population-zero proof semantics
original evidence URLs accompany claim or source metadata summaries

browser format rejects malformed, duplicated and out-of-interval pages
limits: This fixture does not establish capacity for billions of records or sustained hosted latency.
Dated geographic membership and footprint import is a separate contract.
Full original evidence remains in immutable claims; compact pages are a map transport.
